name: Burao
registryAssessment: The official Local Government of Burao District site documents an online land-registration procedure and says land is to be registered in district-government records. This evidences a local registration procedure, but not an open cadastral map, parcel-vector API, or anonymous public parcel lookup.

queries.query: Burao Somalia official cadastral map land registry parcel API local government
queries.result: Found the official Local Government of Burao District online land-registration page and official local-government home page. The service describes applicant registration, technical-officer review, payment, and certificate download; no public map, parcel layer, API, schema, CRS, or safe parcel-ID response was exposed.

officialSources.role: Local Government of Burao District official online land-registration procedure
officialSources.observation: The page states that land in districts should be registered in local-government records and describes login/application, technical review, payment, and certificate-download steps. It does not expose parcel geometry or a public query endpoint.

officialSources.role: Local Government of Burao District official service portal
officialSources.observation: The official portal lists land registration, property registration, land tax, and related municipal services.

officialSources.role: Local Government of Burao District official property-registration procedure
officialSources.observation: The page describes online/offline property-document registration and application workflow; it does not provide anonymous parcel geometry or a safe native parcel identifier.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The official service is an applicant workflow, not an open viewer/API, and the linked application route https://www.burao.govsomaliland.online/land-registration/add returned 404 in the web client. A shell GET attempt also failed DNS resolution for the www host. These failures are not evidence of citywide absence; the exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Local Government of Burao District land/property-registration procedures and publicly indexed Somali land-registry material.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local procedure and service existence only; citywide parcel-vector access, exact-point containment, native identity, schema, CRS, and open coverage were not verified.
